title: Extension stability of complex weights
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $p,a,q,k_0,k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and an isomorphism $\iota:\Qlb\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf C$. Let $X_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme, put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, and use the common-stage coefficient category $D^b_c(X,\Qlb)$ of [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category]. Let
$$
 K'\xrightarrow{u}K\xrightarrow{v}K''
$$
be morphisms of constructible $\Qlb$-Weil complexes, meaning fixed pairs and commuting morphisms as in [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Suppose that the underlying arrows are the first two arrows of a distinguished triangle
$$
 \operatorname{For}K'\xrightarrow{\operatorname{For}u}\operatorname{For}K
 \xrightarrow{\operatorname{For}v}\operatorname{For}K''
 \longrightarrow(\operatorname{For}K')[1]
$$
in $D^b_c(X,\Qlb)$. No triangulated structure on the category of fixed pairs is assumed. For every $w\in\mathbf R$, if $K'$ and $K''$ belong to
$$
 D_{\le w}(X_0):=\{L:\Wt_{\iota,\leq w}(L)\}
$$
in the sense of [def-weil-complex-weights], then so does $K$.

proof.text:
Fix $j\in\mathbf Z$. By [prop-constructible-truncations], the underlying common-stage category has its bounded standard t-structure and cohomology functors $\mathcal H^j$. Apply clause (5) of [lem-weil-heart-short-exact-triangles] to the assumed underlying distinguished triangle. With
$$
 A=\mathcal H^j(K'),\qquad B=\mathcal H^j(K),\qquad C=\mathcal H^j(K''),
$$
this gives underlying arrows $f:A\to B$ and $g:B\to C$ with $\operatorname{im}f=\ker g$ in the constructible heart. These are the cohomology sheaves and induced Weil structures prescribed in [def-weil-complex-weights]. Only the underlying triangle is used; no triangle axiom for fixed pairs is needed.

source.place: First paragraph: the cohomology exact sequence, interpreted in the underlying coefficient category.

proof.text:
The arrows $f,g$ commute with the induced Weil structures. Indeed put $G=Lg_X^*$ and let $c_L:G\mathcal H^j(L)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal H^j(GL)$ be the natural comparison of [prop-constructible-truncations]. For the underlying arrow $u:K'\to K$, naturality and $u\theta_{K'}=\theta_KG(u)$, the morphism condition of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], give
$$
 \mathcal H^j(u)\mathcal H^j(\theta_{K'})c_{K'}
 =\mathcal H^j(\theta_K)\mathcal H^j(G(u))c_{K'}
 =\mathcal H^j(\theta_K)c_KG(\mathcal H^j(u)).
$$
By [def-weil-complex-weights] these composites use precisely the Weil structures on $A,B$. The identical substitution of $v$ for $u$ proves the assertion for $g$.

source.place: Second paragraph: all cohomology arrows are morphisms of Weil sheaves.

proof.text: Take $I=\operatorname{im}f$ and $Q=B/I$ in the constructible heart. Frobenius pullback $G$ is exact on this heart by [lem-a1-constructible-pullback-t-exact], so [lem-sp-exact-functor-preserves-homology] (a),(b) identifies $GI$ with $\operatorname{im}(Gf)$ and $GQ$ with $GB/GI$, compatibly with the inclusion and quotient maps. The intertwining isomorphisms of step 2 therefore induce an isomorphism $GI\to I$ and its quotient isomorphism $GQ\to Q$. Their inverses are induced by the inverse intertwining isomorphisms; hence these really are Weil structures, with $A\twoheadrightarrow I\hookrightarrow B$ and $B\twoheadrightarrow Q$ Weil morphisms. Exactness $I=\ker g$ says that the induced arrow $Q=B/\ker g\to C$ is monic: its kernel is $(\ker g)/I=0$. It commutes with Frobenius after precomposition with the epimorphism $GB\twoheadrightarrow GQ$, by the intertwining equation for $g$. Thus $I$ is a Weil quotient of $A$, $Q$ is a Weil subobject of $C$, and $0\to I\to B\to Q\to0$ is exact in the abelian Weil-sheaf category of [lem-a1-mixed-direct-summand]. The kernel and cokernel universal properties hold there because their unique underlying factorization commutes with Frobenius after composing with the kernel inclusion or the cokernel projection. This is the elementary image/quotient construction, using the cited exact-functor comparisons, not an additional weight lemma.

source.place: Second paragraph: image quotient, image subobject, and their extension, with the Frobenius actions made explicit.

proof.text: The hypotheses and [def-weil-complex-weights] give that $A$ and $C$ are $\iota$-mixed of weights at most $w+j$. Clause (1) of [lem-a1-mixed-direct-summand], applied to $A\twoheadrightarrow I$ and $Q\hookrightarrow C$, gives the same bound for $I$ and $Q$. Clause (2), applied to the short exact sequence $0\to I\to B\to Q\to0$ from step 3, gives that $B=\mathcal H^j(K)$ is $\iota$-mixed of weights at most $w+j$. All these objects and arrows lie in the constructible Weil heart, and the bound is the same real number in the two applications.

source.place: Second paragraph: sheaf-level subquotient stability and extension stability.

proof.text: The argument applies to every integer $j$. Therefore $\mathcal H^j(K)$ is mixed of weights at most $w+j$ for all $j$, which is exactly $\Wt_{\iota,\leq w}(K)$, hence $K\in D_{\le w}(X_0)$, by [def-weil-complex-weights].

source.place: Last sentence: the degreewise bounds are the complex-weight predicate.

proof_origin.place: Both proof paragraphs; corrected interpretation of triangles of fixed pairs and explicit Frobenius image/quotient argument.
